_about: Grandfather list for scripts/test-text-walls.mjs, measured 25 September 2026. Each page here broke a text-wall rule when the guard landed; the numbers are what it measured. A listed page may not get worse on any measure, and one that now passes must be removed (the guard fails until it is), so this list only shrinks. Never raise a number to make the gate pass: shorten the text or put it behind a <details>. 'sentences' are visible sentences of 12+ words (digits normalised to #) on more than 10 pages, with the page count; they may not spread.
